07.
2. Heard Mr. R.K. Acharya, learned counsel for the petitioner and Mr. P.K. Muduli, learned Additional Government Advocate for the State.

3. The petitioner has filed this writ petition seeking to quash the procedure adopted by the opposite parties to acquire the petitioner's land vide notice under Annexure-2 and to direct opposite parties to initiate land acquisition proceeding under Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehablitation and Resettlment Act, 2013 and to pay the due and adequate compensation to the petitioner for use of his land vide Plot No. 591, under Khata No. 525 & Plot No.
629 under Khata No. 526 of Mouza Behera for construction of 4 Lane Biju Express Highway within a stipulated time.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehablitation and Resettlment Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: 4. Mr. Acharya, learned counsel for the petitioner contended that during pendency of the writ petition land acquisition notification has been issued and steps have already taken for grant of compensation.

5. Mr. P.K. Muduli, learned Additional Government Advocate does not dispute such fact and contended that whatever amount the petitioner will be entitled to in accordance with law, the same will be disbursed in his favour.
6. In view of the above, the writ petition stands disposed of.
